skill.summary: Enhanced spectrogram visualization tools for time-frequency analysis. Use when creating spectrograms, spectral analysis, or time-frequency plots for signals...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of pywayne-plot — enhanced spectrogram visualization tools for professional time-frequency analysis.

- Provides advanced spectrogram plotting with support for IMU, physiological, vibration, and audio signal analysis.
- Includes frequency unit conversion (Hz/bpm/kHz) and multiple normalization modes (global/local/none).
- Offers a MATLAB-style perceptually uniform parula colormap.
- Adds helper: `get_specgram_params` for automatic STFT parameter recommendations.
- Custom projection `z_norm` must be registered via `regist_projection()` for enhanced functionality.
